capture_kind: exact reconstructed contract-level first-round prompt string
serializer: Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True), all other arguments at defaults, as executed by the deployed contract expression; UTF-8 output, no added trailing newline.

cases.numeric_type_check: Original registration JSON integers preserved; submission.pr is an integer in the prompt JSON.
Original registration JSON integers preserved; submission.pr is an integer in the prompt JSON.

baseline_input_rule: Give each baseline evaluator only its inputs/<case>.prompt.txt; never include this manifest, provenance, current ledger status, previous evaluations or native outcomes.

field_proofs.objective: Exact constructor calldata parsed from deploy.json matches immutable native get_config.objective.
field_proofs.policy: Exact constructor calldata policy matches native get_config.policy and each original registration policy.
field_proofs.submission: Exact original register calldata string equals archived evidenceJSON, its SHA-256 equals native record.digest, and parsed values equal native record.evidence. The deployed AST removes exactly six identity fields.
field_proofs.prior: The complete append-only registration order contains A then B only. A has never been credited: its terminal round-zero rejected state cannot follow credited under this contract. Each submission has empty dependencies and related_contributions. Therefore no credited prior record exists at either initial adjudication.
field_proofs.historical_ledger_references: Constructor legacy_ledgers is the empty list; config has no predecessor and matches native get_config.
field_proofs.allowed_evidence_refs: Executed original AST expression using proved empty prior and challenges yields [submission ID, historical-ledger]. The historical-ledger label is preserved even with empty history.
field_proofs.required_submission_reference: Exact registration ID bound by native evidence digest and calldata.
field_proofs.challenges: Native records remain in round zero with empty append-only challenge lists; register initializes them empty and challenge only appends and increments round.
field_proofs.challenged: False for the first adjudication: register sets status=submitted, begin_adjudication preserves it, and no round-zero challenge exists.
field_proofs.previous_verdict: Null at the first adjudication: register initializes verdict=None and successful adjudication is the first code path that assigns its verdict. No challenges or prior round exist.
field_proofs.content_merit_ceiling: Null: fresh constructor has no predecessor; A and B are the only registered records and have distinct bundle and statement hashes. _claim_content creates prior=None and accepted=None for each new content key; begin_adjudication changes only round/pending before the first prompt.

limits: This reconstructs the exact string passed to gl.nondet.exec_prompt; it does not claim to recover provider request bytes, hidden system messages, model settings or runtime-injected wrapping.

Native snapshot reads are sequential latest-final reads, not an atomic historical snapshot. Constructor invariants, append-only order, terminal status and round-zero history establish the needed pre-verdict values.
This is an engineering reconstruction, not an independent mathematical evaluation and not a new consensus attempt.
